program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((seen (make-hash))
        (best-score #f)
        (best-cells (list)))
    (define (better? score old)
      (or (not old)
          (> (first score) (first old))
          (and (= (first score) (first old))
               (or (> (second score) (second old))
                   (and (= (second score) (second old))
                        (string<? (third score) (third old)))))))
    (define (cell<? a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (for* ([r (in-range (rows g))] [c (in-range (cols g))])
      (unless (or (hash-has-key? seen (cons r c)) (not (member? (at g r c) (list 0 2))))
        (define queue (list (cons r c)))
        (define cells (list))
        (hash-set! seen (first queue) #t)
        (let bfs ([fuel 0])
          (unless (empty? queue)
            (let ((cur (first queue)))
              (set! queue (rest queue))
              (set! cells (cons (list (car cur) (cdr cur)) cells))
              (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
                (let ((nr (+ (car cur) (first d))) (nc (+ (cdr cur) (second d))))
                  (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                             (member? (at g nr nc) (list 0 2))
                             (not (hash-has-key? seen (cons nr nc))))
                    (hash-set! seen (cons nr nc) #t)
                    (set! queue (append queue (list (cons nr nc))))))))
            (bfs (+ fuel 1))))
        (let* ((sorted-cells (sort cells cell<?))
               (seeds (count-where (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 2)) sorted-cells))
               (score (list seeds (length sorted-cells) (format "~a" (first sorted-cells)))))
          (when (better? score best-score)
            (set! best-score score)
            (set! best-cells sorted-cells)))))
    (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) best-cells 8)))
